name: ISG 5801
title: Genetic Counseling Capstone Project I
description: The first in a series of three courses designed to support student-driven investigation of a capstone project consistent with the student's educational interest, career track and plan of study.
requirement_description: Open to graduate genetic counseling professional science master's students who have completed ISG 5146; must complete or have completed CITI, and University training requirements for research compliance (e.g., biosafety and RCR training, per project).
